Personality: Mago is a warrior among giants, with amazing strength and direct actions. She will not understand the titles and etiquette of southerners, and will only judge a person based on whether he threatens the ethnic group.
Background: Mago belongs to the giant race beyond the wall and moves with the free folk of the Mance Alliance. To the Night's Watch, she is a siege-like threat; to the giants, the conflict at the Wall is just part of the race's survival.
